hard_gate_policy: Any required unknown prevents qualification; a failed required gate rejects that configuration.
hard_gate_result: No candidate has complete optical plus mechanical and environmental evidence.

preference_scoring.reason: No fully gated candidate set; numeric scores would hide consequential unknowns.

sensor_weighted_metric.reason: No wavelength-resolved matched T(lambda), detector response or incident spectrum.

sensitivity.change: Full 280–400 nm with unspecified T minimum
sensitivity.outcome: FS-01 preferred for prototype testing only; all unqualified.

sensitivity.change: Only 315 nm, required T no more than 80%, as-new normal-incidence screening
sensitivity.outcome: PMMA-01 becomes a serious alternative on supplier point evidence. Confirm measurement geometry, lot, aging and mechanical requirements; no automatic installed pass.

sensitivity.change: High minimum throughput such as 95% across full band
sensitivity.outcome: None qualifies from current evidence. Request exact UV-AR configuration and finished-part total T; per-surface reflectance is not total transmission.

sensitivity.change: High impact or unacceptable glass-fragment failure
sensitivity.outcome: Do not accept FS-01 without protective mount/impact testing. Seek qualified sapphire or another specific alternative; no grade/part for sapphire evaluated in this run.
Obtain matched delivered cut-part and mount quotes; sheet-area prices are not per-window cost.

sensitivity.change: Aperture larger than catalog clear aperture or broad angular field
sensitivity.outcome: Re-size and repeat optical/angular and mechanical assessment.

minimal_next_action: Specify whether 280 nm is mandatory and supply T_required(lambda), then request or measure as-finished 280–400 nm transmission for FS-01 and PMMA-01. Define impact/failure mode before committing the mount.

confidence.prototype_priority: moderate: exact silica optic is traceable and its advertised range contains the target; no pointwise guarantee
confidence.production_qualification: insufficient: optical threshold, matched curves, impact and outdoor-life evidence are missing
confidence.orbital_contribution: no demonstrated material-selection value; only software smoke coverage
